evidence_snippets: Some events that may affect App Engine flexible environment minimum number of instances are: Rolling out updates to flexible environment instances Zonal failure (Stockout issues, such as when your region is at capacity for your selected CPU, etc.) App Engine flexible environment uses 3 zones to distribute your instances and in such a configuration, we recommend provisioning 50% more instances than required.
The global external Application Load Balancer sends requests to a service in the App Engine flexible environment regardless of the health of individual instances.
You can set your App Engine flexible environment application's min num instances size when deploying it.
